name: Peter Navarro
role: American economist and White House trade adviser in the first and second Trump administrations
summary: Navarro advocates protective tariffs, industrial onshoring, economic separation from China and strict immigration enforcement. His later speeches oppose major green industrial policies and allege partisan misuse of government, while his earlier record includes environmental and abortion-rights advocacy.

abolish-armed-forces.rationale: Defended military readiness and the industrial capacity to supply wars and allies.

abolish-ip.rationale: The Coming China Wars ch. 11 calls for a zero-tolerance policy on intellectual property theft, with violators punished at the WTO.

abortion-legal.rationale: Only a Wikipedia summary was cited; no source of the person's own words or record was reached.

avoid-deficit-stimulus.rationale: Condemned large fiscal stimulus overspends and prioritized debt reduction.

capital-controls.rationale: Proposed restrictions on Chinese investment and American portfolio flows.

central-bank-independence.rationale: In 2006 he said the Fed is supposed to be independent, and in 2018 he called it independent yet agreed with the President that it raised rates too fast; in 2019 he called its rate rises foolish.

close-ties-china.rationale: Recommended economic and financial decoupling from China.

corporate-influence.rationale: Condemned lavish political contributions protecting offshoring and cheap labor.

drastic-climate-action.rationale: Condemned the Green New Deal approach as destructive to American industry.

economic-self-sufficiency.rationale: Sought reciprocal international exchange, not a completely closed bloc.

expand-fossil-fuels.rationale: Explicitly celebrated fracking and increased American energy production.

expand-nuclear.rationale: Nulled (statement review, 2026-11-12): its rationale rests on nuclear research, enrichment, keeping existing plants open or opposing public support, not on building nuclear power plants, and the statement now asks whether governments should support the construction of nuclear power plants.

foreign-takeover-block.rationale: Proposed banning Chinese investment in strategic technology industries.

free-trade.rationale: Rejected unconditional free-trade claims under nonreciprocal trading rules.

military-superiority.rationale: Welcomed American naval strategic dominance and opposed Chinese military ascendancy.

more-religion-public.rationale: Urged pastors to mobilize congregations politically from their pulpits.

nation-first.rationale: Prioritized American wages, industry and security over prevailing global-trade arrangements.

night-watchman-state.rationale: Advocated active tariff protection and industrial incentives beyond basic security and property enforcement.

open-borders.rationale: Defended deterrence, deportation and employer enforcement against unlawful immigration.

political-elite-corrupt.rationale: Alleged a shadow government and partisan officials concealed election interference.

pollution-taxes.rationale: His earlier writings explicitly endorsed taxes on carbon, gasoline and oil imports.

reduce-immigration.rationale: Explicitly proposed drastically reducing Chinese student and researcher visas.

regulate-corporations.rationale: Made deregulation a central plank of economic growth.

restrict-foreign-funding.rationale: Demanded closing Confucius Institutes as foreign-government influence operations.

space-expansion.rationale: Advocated permanent lunar presence, deep-space industry and sustained outward exploration as national priorities.

state-directs-investment.rationale: Proposed financial and tax incentives for strategic industrial onshoring.

suppress-opposition.rationale: Condemned imprisonment for political disagreement and claimed partisan prosecution.

tariffs-protect-industry.rationale: Explicitly defended tariffs to rebuild American manufacturing.

tax-the-wealthy.rationale: In 2016 he opposed Clinton's tax increases (about $1.3 trillion) and said the Trump plan cuts taxes across the board, including the corporate rate.

taxation-theft.rationale: Defended tariff revenues as legitimate public revenue rather than rejecting all taxation.

trade-labor-env-standards.rationale: In The Coming China Wars ch. 11 he proposes minimum environmental, health and safety standards in every multinational and bilateral trade agreement, enforced, so all nations compete on a level field; in 2017 he said trade should ensure sweatshops meet international minimum-wage and safety standards.

unions-good.rationale: The Coming China Wars says unions have a bad name in rich countries for locking employers into unaffordable contracts, but that workers without representation on health and safety invite exploitation.

voter-id.rationale: Urged passage of legislation restoring voter identification and citizenship safeguards.

notes:
Latest clear trade views supersede earlier free-trade advocacy. The later Green New Deal criticism is recorded alongside an earlier specific carbon-tax endorsement; no explicit later carbon-tax retraction was found. His 2020 climate interview avoided the issue rather than clearly retracting his prior scientific position. No social or constitutional positions inferred from other Project 2025 chapters, party membership or Trump’s policies. Carson’s Christian-national identity claims at the faith event are not Navarro’s. His Green Bay Sweep sought to reject certified 2020 results through Congress and state legislatures; he claimed legality and said violence disrupted it. This controversy does not automatically establish a view on every constitutional-design statement. His fraud and foreign-interference allegations are his assertions, not validated findings. Advocacy of alternative statutory tariff powers after a Supreme Court defeat does not establish opposition to separate branches or unlimited presidential authority. Balanced trade is not an explicit trade-surplus goal. Visa reduction concerns a specific nationality and category; no racial hierarchy inferred. General complaints about gender indoctrination do not identify a specific gender-identity or sex-education law. Remaining nulls reviewed across ten themes.

Merged with an independent claude-sonnet-5-5 audit: 6 answers taken from it, 14 agreed, 0 conflicts settled by the integrator.

claude-sonnet-5-5 notes: Independent second pass (merge). Full texts used: The Coming China Wars (2006), Project 2025 trade chapter (2023), the 2020 Navarro Report, and about 370 CNN/NPR interview transcripts from MediaSum (2002-2020), searched by theme (climate, energy, tax, regulation, unions, welfare, immigration, elections, Fed, NATO, UN, Taiwan, Israel, guns, police, religion, science, democracy, bailouts, defense); those themes mostly returned only trade and economy. Death by China (public upload) is partial (about 10,000 words), Crouching Tiger and In Trump Time are lending-only (401), and I Went to Prison So You Won't Have To was not found on archive.org. Alex Jones corpus not searched. Early career as a San Diego Democrat (1992-2001) was not documented from primary text; later positions supersede. Mixed answers (stimulus, Fed, unions) are 0 at low.
